ITEM 1 | Raspberries: several bright red, glossy-skinned berries clustered in the upper center of the plate, each roughly 2 cm across, with visible drupelet bumps and a slightly soft, juicy look; some are partly overlapping and one or two are shiny with moisture | 55
ITEM 2 | Blackberries: about five dark purple-black, bumpy-surfaced berries roughly 2 to 2.5 cm across, scattered around the raspberries on the left and top of the cluster, with a matte, slightly glossy finish | 50
ITEM 3 | Sliced fruit pieces: a small heap of red, soft-looking strawberry-like pieces with a moist, slightly glossy surface, roughly 3 to 4 cm across in total, sitting beside and partly under the raspberries near the center of the cluster | 40
ITEM 4 | Dark brown bar-shaped piece: a single elongated, flat strip about 13 cm long and 2 to 2.5 cm wide, with a matte, slightly rough, grainy surface and slightly uneven edges, medium-dark reddish-brown in color, lying diagonally across the lower right of the plate, appearing dense and firm with a faint cut or fibrous texture | 45
